HADJI YUSOPH, MD. Municipal Mayor Municipality of Poona Piagapo Province of Lanao del Norte Dear Mayor Yusoph: This has reference to your letter requesting for the immediate filling up of vacancies in the Sangguniang Barangay of Kablangan, Piagapo, Lanao Del Norte caused by the death of the Punong Barangay and the subsequent mass resignation of the seven (7) sangguniang barangay members of the same barangay. The vacancies allegedly existed since 19 April 2009. Thereafter, the Association of Barangay Councils of the said municipality said to have passed ABC Resolution NO. 03-09 Series of 2009 which was made the basis for you to submit recommendees to fill in the vacancies. Notwithstanding the number of communications and indorsements that were issued pertaining to the above since you first directed your request to H.E. President Gloria Macapagal Arroyo on 25 September 2009, the Office of the President referred this back to this Department for appropriate action. In the present case, there exists a permanent vacancy in the ENTIRE Sangguniang Barangay of Kablangan, such that there is a physical and legal impossibility for the said sanggunian to even make a list of recommendees to the Municipal Mayor for the latter to appoint at all qualified persons for the position. This brings us to resolve an issue as to who the proper appointing authority is when a permanent vacancy occurs in the entire sangguniang barangay . In reply thereto, we are of the view that it is Office of the President of the Philippines, thru the Executive Secretary, who is empowered to appoint Republic of Philippines DEVARIW_.UT nu LOCAL GOVERA.HI ns CATE OSEC10-003783

2 qualified persons to fill in the vacant posts in the Sangguniang Barangay of Kablangan, Piagapo, Lanao Del Norte. The peculiar nature of your case and the absence of any particular provision in any law or statute warrants an extraordinary but legal remedy to resolve the same. Thus, we anchor our legal basis in no less than our Constitution itself, particularly Section 16, Article VII thereof, wherein the President of the is empowered to "appoint all other officers of the Repu blic Government whose appointments are NOT OTHERWISE PROVIDED for by Zaw". It is therefore recommended that the prior request made and the list of recommendees submitted by your good office to H.E. President Gloria Macapagal Arroyo be maintained. We hope that the foregoing sufficiently addresses your concern. Very truly yours, AUSTERE A. P Undersecretary Copy Furnished: Atty.
